PRIVACY

Privacy policy

Last updated: 1 October 2026

This policy explains how Surecomply Services handles information associated with this website, enquiries, and digital service projects.

Information we receive

When you contact us, we may receive your name, contact details, project requirements, correspondence, and files you choose to share. When you purchase a service, we may keep invoice and transaction-reference information needed to manage the engagement.

How information is used

We use this information to respond to enquiries, prepare quotes, carry out agreed work, deliver files, provide support, manage refunds, and meet applicable record-keeping obligations. Please provide only information relevant to your project.

Website data and cookies

This website has no enquiry form, customer account, advertising trackers, or analytics scripts added by Surecomply Services. The hosting provider may process technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to serve and protect the website.

Service providers and payments

Email, hosting, file-delivery, and payment providers may process information needed to provide their services under their own privacy terms. If a third-party payment page is used, payment credentials are entered with that provider. We do not request full card details, banking passwords, or one-time passwords by email or phone.

Project materials

Project files are used for the agreed service. We do not publish client materials as portfolio work without permission. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information unless it is necessary for the agreed work.

Retention and security

We retain information for the project, related support, and applicable legal or accounting obligations. We take reasonable measures to restrict access and protect the information we handle. No method of transmission or storage can be guaranteed completely secure.

Your requests

You may contact aj@tndn.in to ask about your information, request corrections, or request deletion where applicable. Some records may need to be retained to meet legal obligations or resolve an ongoing matter.

Policy changes

Changes will be published on this page with an updated date.
